title: Country Music Cottage - Close to Nashville!
description:
Come visit 'Country Music Cottage' Located 20-25 mins from Nashville's downtown Honky Tonks!

Be one of the first to enjoy this new addition to our collection.
This cute 3 bedroom cottage features cozy bedrooms and living spaces that are inviting to welcome your family or small group. Adorned with a well equipped kitchen, ample dining space and an amazing outdoor area to share stories with friends or play a game of corn hole!

The space
Sit around the fire-pit at night or under the fairy lit covered back porch. Play a song or two on the guitars as you indulge in the essence of Nashville.

Ubering in and out of Nashville is easy and you are just 20 minutes from the Nashville Airport too.

This home is located on the North side of Nashville in a town called Hendersonville which is dubbed 'The City By The Lake'. You are 5-10 minutes from multiple marinas that feature boat rentals, restaurant dining and live music most days of the week in-season.

Grocery stores, retail shopping, dining and bars are all within 5-10mins throughout Hendersonville too!

We hope you enjoy staying with us at Country Music Cottage and be sure to come back and visit us again...

Guest access
Be sure to see the 1000+ reviews we have on other properties and be one of the first to enjoy this new addition to our collection.
